limitations: One board per chip, one AP and room-temperature conditions; no calibrated RF measurement or long-duration reliability claim.

Both S3 RX spur routines replaced. Neither chip retains an RX-calibration archive member. TX calibration, analog callbacks and ROM dependencies remain. C3 has a compatibility build and restoration trial only in this milestone.
Original-instruction oracle compares ordered modeled boundary behavior; it does not prove cycle timing, RF or analog equivalence.
Packet gaps and latency tails remain open; this comparison records actual counts without claiming a fix.
AP Ethernet captures corroborate EAPOL exchanges but are not complete independent RF captures.

timing_observations.limits: Cumulative metrics cannot correlate a particular packet with an operation. Group losses in the comparison are preserved separately. No cycle-equivalence or packet-loss fix is claimed.

final_board_state.esp32c3: ordinary source app completed and disconnected
final_board_state.esp32s3: held in ROM by paired flasher; ordinary source app retained

validation_notes: Actual emitted spur instructions and ELF constants checked in all four S3 source profiles: 17,232 case executions. Every native PC and conditional edge is covered without exemptions.

Original traces cover seven-argument scalar narrowing, signed channel masks and shifts, live callbacks, wrapped wide arithmetic with carry, signed QUOS and early exit after sampling. Analog effects remain outside the model.
Thirty-two zero-divisor cases preserve boundary effects before the Xtensa exception. The model does not emulate exception frames or handlers. Native QUOS has a memory effect barrier.
Every retained calibration input name and size is identical across each control/source profile. Only the selected original spur inputs disappear on S3; C3 ownership remains unchanged.
Images were built at the implementation commit; recorded source hashes and committed Cargo locks bind them to that revision. The control has only the identical passive lifetime probe overlay.
C3 is a compatibility build and ordinary-source restoration check, not a paired spur trial. The four lifetime/RX and four paired station trials run on S3.
Local Cargo repro tests use installed Rust 1.91.0; serial tests use the ESP-IDF Python environment with pyserial 3.5. Default toolchains and locks are unchanged.
